svg.title: Saving paused: missing settings file
svg.desc: The settings' main page while saving is paused, showing only its first box, the actual Saving is paused notice, with the brush mascot standing calm where the warning triangle would be, and the Version history box further down the page. No settings file is read or written.

text.font-family: "??", "??", "??", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Google Sans Flex", Roboto, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", sans-serif

g.text: First of all, take a deep breath — everything is going to be okay. Your notes are safe, and your callouts are still

text.font-family: "??", "??", "??", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Google Sans Flex", Roboto, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", sans-serif

g.text: here on this device. Callout Studio has only paused saving to protect your setup, so this page is read-only for

g.text: Callout Studio can't find its settings file. This usually happens while your sync app is still downloading it, or

g.text: after Callout Studio was removed on another device.

g.text: Callout Studio checks again every minute while Obsidian is open, so this often fixes itself — or choose Check

g.text: again to look right now. If your settings don't come back, choose Restore these settings to keep the callouts
